name: date-arithmetic
objective: A project starts on 2026-03-15 and lasts exactly 45 days. On what date does it end (start day counts as day 1)?
output_contract: A single ISO date with a one-line calculation.

candidates.A: Counting 45 days from 2026-03-15 gives 2026-04-29, since March has 31 days and we add the remainder into April.
candidates.B: Day 1 is 2026-03-15; March contributes 17 days (15th-31st), leaving 28 days into April → 2026-04-28. Wait, 28 days into April is 2026-04-28, so the project ends 2026-05-01.
candidates.C: Day 1 is 2026-03-15, so days 1-17 cover 2026-03-15 through 2026-03-31; the remaining 28 days run 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-28. End date: 2026-04-28.
